title: Cosmic Egg King
description: A yellow anthropomorphic egg wearing a golden crown, red bow tie and green beard stands beside a tall black silhouette of a woman with long flowing purple galaxy hair. They are reflected in rippling water below against a vibrant cosmic nebula background filled with stars and galaxies.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a smug yellow egg character with a tiny golden crown, red bow tie and textured green beard standing next to a tall elegant black silhouette of a woman whose long flowing hair merges with purple and pink galaxy patterns and stars. Both figures are reflected in dark rippling water below. The background is a vibrant space nebula with green, purple and pink clouds, distant galaxies and stars. Whimsical yet majestic atmosphere, detailed digital painting style.
